goal: Prepare the selected Sonnet 5.5 ten-dollar research pilot and execute paid verification when its credential and adapter boundaries are available.

Verify shared ten-dollar reservation enforcement, no-refund failure accounting and replay rejection across concurrent gateways and restart.
Complete the authorized paid pilot using native Anthropic credentials and independently evaluated research outputs.

outcome.summary: The text-only gateway foundation and budget tests pass. No paid call or real research evaluation ran; the launcher lacks the required native API credential and the existing research route is Codex-only.

exception.reason: The designated Anthropic API credential is unavailable in the launcher environment. Real tool-enabled research additionally requires a fixed compatible adapter rather than a model-name substitution.
exception.next_action: Make the native Anthropic credential available to the approved launcher without sharing its value; freeze and verify exact transfer scope before paid dispatch, and implement verified tool-history replay for the real research adapter.

what_worked: Official compatibility documentation exposed a breaking thinking-mode change before a paid request.
The new model is pinned to a distinct pricing identity, and unsupported tools, signed replay, sampling overrides and fallback fail before reservation.
The existing durable ledger preserves the campaign cap across concurrent clients, failures and restart.
what_failed: Paid execution could not start because the native launcher credential is absent.
Initial synthetic tests assumed both concurrent calls would acquire the fail-fast ledger lease and double-closed a server; test setup was corrected without relaxing budget behavior.

evidence.summary: Sixteen new tests and eighty-nine historical gateway tests pass using synthetic upstream responses without credentials or provider calls.
Repository gate passes with 1349 tests passed and seven integration skips, including types, build, capsules and deterministic evaluation gates.
Owns new model admission, conservative price assumptions, ten-dollar pilot allocation, protected authority and remaining runtime gates.

Presence-only launcher preflight found the designated Anthropic API credential unavailable. No credential values or project environment files were read. Source inspection also identified the existing worker's Codex-only route.

uncertainty.statement: Offline admission and accounting tests do not establish real API availability, billing, native worker compatibility or a research quality gain.
uncertainty.resolution: Run the exact authorized live request with native credentials, then verify the research adapter and evaluator independently.

notes: The user selected the model and total allocation and requested execution. No exact outbound manifest approval, plugin mount or profile mutation was exercised.
